shapeFit.method: Shared geometric head fit; checked physical nose/mouth points and visible per-view jaw/cheek contours. Camera adjustments are analysis-only.
limitations: Uncalibrated photographs do not establish physical facial dimensions.
Camera intrinsics, expressions, glasses, beard edges and soft tissue add uncertainty.
No eye-corner detector hit is an anatomical correspondence.
The front image smiles; its lip opening is excluded.
